notes.title: HD remake update is now available!
notes.content:
There is No GreenDam is now updated in HD remake!

Compared to the old version, the new version has the following features:
- 1920x1080 resolution support
- Live2D support
- New UI
- Add English language

Some Q&As about the new version

[b]Q: Can I inherit the old version archive? [/b]
A: Unfortunately, no. If you need to switch back to the old version, you can do so by right-clicking the game in the Steam library -> Properties -> Beta -> select "krkr ver.(old version)" and wait for Steam to download the game again.

[b]Q: Can I switch to static artwork? [/b]
A: Yes, you can. You can switch between Live2D and static stills in the game's settings menu.

Finally, it's time for the annual 苍绿祭.
If you like GreenDam, please support the creations of other GreenDam creators.
You can also use the #苍绿祭 tag on any social media platform to share what you want to say to GreenDam, or GreenDam's works ~
